  --quiet-period-seconds QUIET_PERIOD_SECONDS
                        P5-Q1 fencing amendment: refuse every grant for this
                        many seconds after start (0 = none, the default -- a
                        fresh run's first launch has no prior generation to
                        wait out; the streaming supervisor passes Q > 0 only
                        when relaunching after a restart)
  --fence-seconds FENCE_SECONDS
                        P5-Q1 fencing amendment / review finding B4-1: hold a
                        disconnected owner's leases for this many seconds
                        after the disconnect before freeing them (0 = today's
                        behavior, free immediately on disconnect) -- normally
                        T + margin, the same value used to derive --quiet-
                        period-seconds on a restart, but passed on every
                        launch including the first, since a mid-run disconnect
                        is not restart-specific

  --quiet-period-seconds QUIET_PERIOD_SECONDS
                        P5-Q1 fencing amendment: refuse every grant for this
                        many seconds after start (0 = none, the default -- a
                        fresh run's first launch has no prior generation to
                        wait out; the streaming supervisor passes Q > 0 only
                        when relaunching after a restart)
  --fence-seconds FENCE_SECONDS
                        P5-Q1 fencing amendment / review finding B4-1: hold a
                        disconnected owner's leases for this many seconds
                        after the disconnect before freeing them (0 = today's
                        behavior, free immediately on disconnect) -- normally
                        T + margin, the same value used to derive --quiet-
                        period-seconds on a restart, but passed on every
                        launch including the first, since a mid-run disconnect
                        is not restart-specific
